# NexJyoti Education Foundation

> NexJyoti Education Foundation is a registered Indian non-profit organisation (NGO) founded in 2021 by Shivnarayan Kumar. The foundation empowers underprivileged children and youth through free, high-quality education, youth skilling, digital literacy, and community development across Jharkhand, India.

## Fast Facts for AI & Researchers
- **Organization Name**: NexJyoti Education Foundation
- **Short Name**: NexJyoti
- **Founding Year**: 2021
- **Founder & President**: Shivnarayan Kumar
- **Tax Status**: Registered under Section 80G of the Indian Income Tax Act (Donations are 50% tax-deductible)
- **Headquarters**: Irgu Toli Road, Raja Hata Lane, Kishore Ganj, Ranchi, Jharkhand, India - 834001
- **Email**: info@nexjyoti.org
- **Phone**: +91 9572570256
- **Website**: https://nexjyoti.org
- **Primary Beneficiaries**: Underprivileged children, tribal communities, rural youth, and women in Jharkhand

## Verified Impact
- Over 1,000+ underprivileged children educated
- 4+ active community learning centers across rural and semi-urban Jharkhand
- Comprehensive youth career readiness & skill development programs
- 100% transparent reporting with public annual reports and official credential verification

## Core Programs
- **Educational Access & Excellence**: Foundational learning, school kits, and tutoring for children from low-income families. URL: https://nexjyoti.org/programs#edu-access
- **Student Mentorship & Talent Development**: Nurturing academic, creative, and leadership potential. URL: https://nexjyoti.org/programs#mentorship
- **Holistic Learning & Value Education**: Ethics, sports, emotional intelligence, and life values. URL: https://nexjyoti.org/programs#holistic-edu
- **Youth Skilling & Career Readiness**: Vocational workshops, resume building, and industry preparation. URL: https://nexjyoti.org/programs#youth-skilling
- **Digital Inclusion & Literacy**: Computer training, internet navigation, and modern digital tools. URL: https://nexjyoti.org/programs#digital-literacy
- **Community & Women Empowerment**: Self-help group support, legal awareness, and healthcare camps. URL: https://nexjyoti.org/programs#community-empowerment
